about.title: About
bio: My journey in computer science has progressively led me to explore different aspects of development and digital technologies. After a third year mainly focused on development, during which I had the opportunity to work on several projects, I discovered in my fourth year another aspect of computer science through Artificial Intelligence and Data.

What I particularly like about this field is its diversity: understanding a problem, asking the right questions, researching different approaches, experimenting and building a concrete solution. I am naturally curious and I enjoy learning new technologies by first understanding how they work, then putting them into practice.

I define myself today as a versatile and adaptable profile, with an interest in development, AI and Data. I also appreciate teamwork, where exchanges allow us to confront ideas and explore different solutions.

My goal for the future is to progressively move from academic learning to concrete professional problems, through a final year project that will allow me to learn, contribute and put my skills into practice.

immoai.title: IMMO-AI — Intelligent Real Estate Analysis Platform
immoai.shortDescription: Real estate analysis platform dedicated to the Moroccan market with multi-agent AI pipeline, semantic search and estimation tools.
immoai.problem: The Moroccan real estate market lacks centralized tools enabling intelligent property analysis. Information is scattered across multiple platforms (mubawab.ma, avito.ma, etc.), making comparison, reliable price estimation and profitability evaluation difficult for investors and buyers.
immoai.overview: IMMO-AI is a real estate analysis platform dedicated to the Moroccan market. The project aims to provide intelligent tools for property analysis, price estimation and profitability evaluation, using AI and Machine Learning techniques.
immoai.objective: Develop a complete platform allowing users to search, analyze and evaluate real estate properties in Morocco thanks to advanced AI tools, including semantic search, automatic price estimation and neighborhood analysis.
immoai.solution: An integrated web platform combining automated scraping, multi-agent AI pipeline for qualitative analysis, semantic search, price estimation, neighborhood scoring, and interactive interface with Leaflet map to visualize and compare properties.
immoai.myRole: Designer / Developer with full-stack and AI/Data contribution. Participation in backend (development, API, component integration, frontend/backend exchanges), scraping (system development, real estate data collection, preparation/normalization, integration), AI pipeline (multi-agent pipeline implementation, component integration/orchestration, agent results integration), frontend (React, API integration, interfaces, Leaflet map, exports), and documentation (project report and documentation). Team project.
immoai.teamWork: Collective development of the IMMO-AI platform with integration of different components (scraping, backend, AI pipeline, frontend). The project was carried out as a team with task distribution according to each member's skills.
immoai.architecture: Client-server architecture with FastAPI backend and React/Vite frontend. PostgreSQL database for real estate data storage. Multi-agent AI pipeline for data processing and analysis. Data flow follows the scheme: Collection (mubawab.ma scraping) → Preparation/normalization → Storage (PostgreSQL) → Multi-agent AI pipeline → Analysis/scoring/estimation → FastAPI API → React Frontend → Restitution (map, comparator, exports).
immoai.methodology: Agile approach with iterative development. Automated collection of ads via scraping, processing by multi-agent AI pipeline (5 specialized agents), and React user interface for visualization and interaction.
immoai.pipelineIA: Multi-agent system composed of 5 specialized agents: Collection agent (raw data retrieval), Normalization agent (format standardization), Qualitative analysis agent (description evaluation), Estimation agent (price calculation), Scoring agent (neighborhood evaluation). Agents communicate via an orchestrated architecture that coordinates their inputs/outputs to produce a consolidated analysis of each property.
immoai.scraping: Automated scraping system targeting mubawab.ma for real estate ad collection. Using BeautifulSoup4 and httpx for data extraction (price, location, characteristics, description). Collected data is normalized and stored in PostgreSQL for further processing by the AI pipeline.
immoai.semanticSearch: Semantic search based on Sentence Transformers with the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model for encoding real estate descriptions into vectors. Using Groq for LLM inference with the llama-3.3-70b-versatile model, enabling natural language queries and contextual responses. The system allows searching for properties by description, intention or complex criteria, beyond simple keyword search.
immoai.backend: Backend developed with FastAPI and Python 3.11. RESTful API for exposing features (search, estimation, scoring). Using SQLAlchemy for ORM and communication with PostgreSQL. Integration with AI pipeline via asynchronous calls. Frontend request management and orchestration of different components.
immoai.frontend: Frontend developed with React and Vite. Reactive user interface with API integration for real-time data retrieval. Interactive Leaflet map for geographic visualization of properties. Comparison module to put several ads side by side. Export features (PDF/Excel) for analyses. Integrated chatbot with natural language search.
immoai.features: Semantic search of ads, automatic price estimation, necessary work evaluation, profitability calculation (rental yield, return), neighborhood scoring (accessibility, services, security), overall property score, interactive map with filtering, multi-ad comparator, PDF/Excel exports, real estate chatbot with natural language search.
immoai.implementation: Development of an automated real estate ad collection system, implementation of a multi-agent AI pipeline for qualitative analysis, creation of a React interface with interactive Leaflet map, development of PDF/Excel export features, and integration of a real estate chatbot with natural language search.
immoai.results: Functional platform with semantic search, price estimation, work evaluation, profitability calculation, neighborhood score, overall score, interactive map, comparator and chatbot.
immoai.challenges: Integration of AI models for qualitative analysis, management of large-scale data collection, synchronization between AI pipeline and user interface.
immoai.improvements: Adding more data sources, improving estimation models, expanding chatbot features, performance optimization.

medicareplus.title: Medicare+ — Medical Management Platform
medicareplus.shortDescription: Digital platform designed to improve medical information management, data flow, care coordination and accessibility.
medicareplus.problem: Medical information management is often fragmented across different systems and actors, complicating care coordination, data flow and accessibility for patients and healthcare professionals.
medicareplus.overview: Medicare+ is a digital platform designed to improve medical information management, data flow, care coordination and accessibility for patients and healthcare professionals.
medicareplus.objective: Design a platform enabling more effective and centralized management of medical information, improving administrative and clinical processes, coordination between actors, communication, accessibility and data security.
medicareplus.solution: Web platform developed with Python, Django and MySQL to centralize medical information management, facilitate coordination between healthcare actors and improve data accessibility for patients and professionals.
medicareplus.myRole: Project carried out in pairs. Participation in requirements analysis, UML and Merise modeling, Django backend development, HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend development with Bootstrap, and implementation of main features (appointment management, medical records, prescriptions, notifications).
medicareplus.teamWork: Pair development of the Medicare+ platform with task distribution according to each member's skills.
medicareplus.architecture: Django MTV architecture (Model-Template-View). The Model defines the data structure and interactions with the database via Django ORM. The Template manages data presentation with HTML files and Django tags. The View processes HTTP requests and orchestrates interactions between the model and the template. SQLite database for development.
medicareplus.methodology: Structured approach with planning and requirements analysis phases, design with UML diagrams (use cases, sequence, classes) and Merise (MCD), Django backend and HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend development, thorough testing, and deployment.
medicareplus.implementation: Django backend development with ORM for data management (users, patients, doctors, pharmacists, appointments, prescriptions, medications, medical records, notifications). Creation of HTML templates with Django for dynamic interfaces. Bootstrap integration for responsive design. Chart.js usage for medical data visualization. SQLite database for development.
medicareplus.features: Registration and authentication by role (patient, doctor, pharmacist, administrator), appointment taking and management, consultation and modification of medical records, creation and validation of prescriptions by pharmacists, patient medical journal, automatic notifications (treatment reminders), secure communication between patients and professionals, and role-specific dashboards.
medicareplus.results: Functional platform with role-specific dashboards (patient, doctor, pharmacist, administrator). Operational features: registration and authentication by role, appointment taking and management, consultation and modification of medical records, creation and validation of prescriptions, patient medical journal, automatic notifications, and responsive interface.
medicareplus.improvements: Integration of artificial intelligence for predictive analysis of chronic patients' health status, development of a complementary mobile application to strengthen accessibility, addition of a teleconsultation module with secure messaging and video conferencing, interfacing with other medical systems via APIs to strengthen interoperability, and implementation of analytical dashboards for doctors and health decision-makers.

videostudio.title: Video Studio — Video Management Platform
videostudio.shortDescription: Web platform for video recording and management with video editing module.
videostudio.problem: Video management often requires complex and scattered tools. Users need a centralized solution allowing recording, storage, editing and organization of video content without requiring multiple software.
videostudio.overview: Web platform developed at JOBGATE/UM6P StartGate allowing video recording and management with an integrated editing module.
videostudio.objective: Create a complete solution for video management including upload, storage, editing and organization of video content.
videostudio.solution: Microservices architecture with frontend/backend separation. Django REST Framework backend for secure APIs, React.js frontend for reactive interface, FFmpeg for video processing (cutting, compression), PostgreSQL for storage, Nginx as reverse proxy for HTTPS and video distribution, and Docker for containerization and service orchestration.
videostudio.myRole: Full-stack developer. Participation in requirements analysis, modeling, React frontend development, Django REST backend development, implementation of video editing module with FFmpeg, and design of database architecture.
videostudio.teamWork: Team project at JOBGATE/UM6P StartGate with collaboration on different parts of the platform.
videostudio.architecture: Layered architecture: Frontend (React.js with specialized components: VideoRecording, VideoEditor, VideoTimeline, MyVideos, MobileStudio), Backend (Django REST with ViewSets: VideoPresentationViewSet, VideoSessionViewSet, VideoEditor service), Infrastructure (Docker Compose for orchestration, Nginx reverse proxy for HTTPS and distribution, PostgreSQL for persistence). Communication via secure REST APIs. FFmpeg integrated in backend for video processing.
videostudio.methodology: Agile approach with iterative development. Planning and requirements analysis, UML design (use cases, activity diagram, logical architecture), Django REST backend development with FFmpeg integration, React.js frontend development with Bootstrap, REST API integration, unit and functional testing, Docker deployment with Nginx and HTTPS.
videostudio.implementation: Development of React.js interface with modular components (VideoRecording for webcam, VideoEditor for editing, VideoTimeline for temporal navigation, MobileStudio for QR code, MyVideos for management). Creation of Django REST APIs with secure authentication. FFmpeg integration for video cutting, compression and thumbnail generation. PostgreSQL configuration for user and metadata storage. Docker Compose deployment with containerized services (React, Django, Nginx, PostgreSQL). Nginx configuration for HTTPS and video distribution.
videostudio.results: Functional platform with desktop video recording (webcam) and mobile (via QR code), light editing (start/end cutting), video management (viewing, deletion, validation), thumbnail generation, system notifications, administrator monitoring, and support for WebM and MP4 formats with maximum duration of 5 minutes.
videostudio.challenges: FFmpeg integration for real-time video processing, management of large files (100 MB limit), synchronization between frontend and backend, network error management, validation of cutting parameters, recovery in case of timeout, camera/microphone permission management, and video metadata extraction.
videostudio.improvements: AI video analysis module for improvement suggestions, robust authentication system with secure user management, finalization of video trimming system for more flexibility, AI simulator for candidate practical tests, dynamic instructions personalized by activity domain, integrated lighting system (ring light), improvement of video metadata extraction.

caregraphcomplete.title: CareGraph Complete — Medical Multi-Agent Workflow
caregraphcomplete.shortDescription: Academic application simulating preliminary clinical triage based on LangGraph with multi-agents, FastAPI API, MCP integration, Streamlit interface and Human-in-the-Loop.
caregraphcomplete.problem: Clinical triage systems often require complex workflows involving multiple steps and actors. It is difficult to design a solution that allows collecting patient information, generating relevant clinical questions, producing a preliminary summary, involving a physician for validation, and generating a structured final report.
caregraphcomplete.overview: CareGraph Complete is an academic application simulating a preliminary clinical triage workflow. The project is part of a medical multi-agent system based on LangGraph, with a FastAPI API, MCP integration, Streamlit interface and a Human-in-the-Loop step for medical validation.
caregraphcomplete.objective: Design a multi-agent workflow with LangGraph allowing to collect a patient case, generate 5 clinical questions via LLM, produce a preliminary clinical summary with identification of red flags, involve a physician for human validation, and generate a structured final report.
caregraphcomplete.solution: LangGraph multi-agent architecture with 4 specialized agents: Supervisor (orchestration), Diagnostic Agent (question generation and clinical summary), Physician Review (Human-in-the-Loop for medical validation), Report Agent (final report generation). Using OpenAI for LLM generation, MCP integration for clinical rules, FastAPI API for route exposure, and Streamlit interface for end user.
caregraphcomplete.myRole: Individual design and development of the project, from requirements analysis to implementation and realization of different features.
caregraphcomplete.architecture: LangGraph multi-agent architecture with 4 nodes: Supervisor (conditional router), Diagnostic Agent (question generation and summary), Physician Review (interrupt for Human-in-the-Loop), Report Agent (report generation). Shared MedicalState containing thread_id, patient_case, patient_profile, questions, patient_answers, red_flags, diagnostic_summary, final_report. FastAPI backend with routes /sessions/start, /consultation/start, /consultation/resume, /consultation/{thread_id}, /consultation/{thread_id}/report. Local MCP server for clinical rules. Streamlit frontend for user interface. In-memory persistence with InMemorySaver.
caregraphcomplete.methodology: Iterative approach with LangGraph graph development, implementation of specialized agents, OpenAI integration for LLM generation, creation of MCP server for clinical rules, FastAPI API development with required routes, implementation of LangGraph interruptions for Human-in-the-Loop, Streamlit interface development, and complete scenario testing.
caregraphcomplete.implementation: Development of LangGraph graph with StateGraph and InMemorySaver. Creation of 4 agents (supervisor, diagnostic_agent, physician_review, report_agent) with conditional routing logic. OpenAI integration via openai_service.py for question generation, clinical summary and final report. Implementation of MCP server with get_clinical_rules tool. FastAPI API development with required routes and interruption management via Command(resume=...). Streamlit interface creation with screens: home, patient questions, physician review, final report. Docker Compose configuration for backend/frontend orchestration.
caregraphcomplete.features: Consultation session start, patient case entry (case, profile, urgency, context), automatic generation of 5 clinical questions via OpenAI, patient answer collection with shared state, preliminary clinical summary generated by LLM, identification of red flags, general intermediate recommendation, Human-in-the-Loop step for physician validation, physician conduct entry, generation of structured final report in Markdown, report export in Markdown, Streamlit interface with multiple screens, technical data panel to observe graph state, mandatory ethical warning in final report.
caregraphcomplete.results: Functional platform with complete multi-agent workflow. Tests performed: API start, Streamlit frontend access, consultation start, OpenAI question generation, graph resume after patient answer, collection of 5 answers, physician review passage, resume after validation, final report generation. Complete scenario executed successfully (initial status patient_questions, 5 questions/answers, final status finished, report generated). Compliance with specifications: 17/17 requirements compliant.
caregraphcomplete.challenges: Management of LangGraph interruptions for Human-in-the-Loop, synchronization of shared state between agents, OpenAI integration with error management, local fallback for MCP server in case of problem, in-memory persistence (no database), quality of responses depending on configured OpenAI model.
caregraphcomplete.improvements: Add database for consultation history, automatic report export in PDF, unit tests and automated integration tests, user authentication, logging of graph steps, improvement of OpenAI error management, test scenario comparison interface, versioned prompts to facilitate evaluation.

bookingexpress.title: BookingExpress — Hotel Booking Mobile Application
bookingexpress.shortDescription: Hotel booking mobile application developed with React Native and Expo, allowing search, exploration and reservation of accommodations.
bookingexpress.problem: Users need a simple and intuitive mobile solution to search, explore and book hotels. Existing applications can be complex or lack essential features like a shopping cart system or smooth navigation.
bookingexpress.overview: BookingExpress is a hotel booking mobile application developed with React Native and Expo. The application allows users to search hotels by destination, dates and number of travelers, explore a list of accommodations with images and details, and manage a shopping cart for reservations.
bookingexpress.objective: Develop a complete hotel booking mobile application with an intuitive user interface, including search, filters, accommodation details, shopping cart system and tab navigation.
bookingexpress.solution: React Native mobile application with Expo for cross-platform development. Tab navigation with Expo Router. User interface with React Native components and StyleSheet. Local state management with React hooks. Static accommodation data for demonstration. Shopping cart system with total calculation. Modals for hotel details and cart.
bookingexpress.myRole: Participation in the development of the hotel booking mobile application with React Native and Expo, including user interface, navigation, shopping cart system and search features.
bookingexpress.teamWork: Academic mobile development project carried out as a team during a semester of studies.
bookingexpress.architecture: React Native architecture with Expo for cross-platform development (iOS, Android, Web). Tab navigation with Expo Router and React Navigation Bottom Tabs. Local state management with React hooks (useState). Modular components for user interface (hotel cards, modals, search forms). Integrated static data (hotelsData) for demonstration. StyleSheet for responsive styling.
bookingexpress.methodology: Iterative approach with UI component development, tab navigation implementation, search and filter system creation, shopping cart system development, modal integration for details and cart, and testing on different platforms.
bookingexpress.implementation: User interface development with React Native and StyleSheet. Creation of hotel card components with images, ratings, stars and amenities. Tab navigation implementation (Explore, Favorites, Reservations, Profile) with Expo Router. Search system development with filters (price, stars, amenities, type). Shopping cart system creation with add, remove and total calculation. Modal implementation for hotel details and cart. Icon integration with @expo/vector-icons. Expo configuration for iOS, Android and Web.
bookingexpress.features: Hotel search (destination, dates, travelers), filters (price, stars, amenities, type), hotel list with visual cards, hotel details (image, location, rating, stars, description, amenities), shopping cart system, cart total calculation, simulated payment with Alert, tab navigation (Explore, Favorites, Reservations, Profile), user profile with menu, 'Popular' badges on certain hotels, star rating system, mobile responsive design.
bookingexpress.results: Functional mobile application with complete user interface. Operational search system with filters. Hotel list with test data (5 Parisian hotels). Functional shopping cart with add, remove and total calculation. Hotel detail modal with complete information. Functional tab navigation. User profile with menu. Simulated payment system.
bookingexpress.challenges: Local state management with React hooks, modal implementation for good user experience, responsive design for different mobile screen sizes, static data management for demonstration, tab navigation integration with Expo Router.
bookingexpress.improvements: Integration of backend API for real accommodation data, addition of database for user reservations, user authentication implementation, addition of favorites and reservation history features, integration of real payment system, unit tests and automated integration tests, performance optimization for large accommodation lists.
